content.text: {"id": "mm6928a3", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "There was a significant difference in the prevalence of hospitalization of mumps patients living with HIV infection"}, {"loc": "summary", "q": "A fourfold increase in mumps cases was reported during 2018 compared with 2017"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Among these 110 patients, 76 (69%) were male"}]}, {"v": "count/rate", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "the 116 mumps cases among adults exceeded the number observed during the previous 5 years combined (80)"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Nineteen (17%) mumps patients were persons living with HIV infection"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "There was a significant difference in the prevalence of hospitalization of mumps patients living with HIV infection"}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "outbreak investigation", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "An epidemiologic analysis of routine and supplementary data, including spatiotemporal analysis, was performed to describe mumps cases"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Fisher’s exact test was used to identify differences in prevalence estimates using SAS (version 9.4; SAS Institute)"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "retrospective spatiotemporal cluster detection by patient residence, using a discrete space-time Poisson model"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Data from adults with mumps reported during 2018 were analyzed, excluding adults for whom the standard questionnaire was not completed."}], "confidence": "high", "uncertain_fields": []}
